faqs.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.description: Still unsure? Our support team is here to answer your questions and guide you every step of the way.
faqs.faq_a_1: Trading - buying and selling in financial markets - is a modern phenomenon and fundamental economic activity that has evolved over centuries. Trading essentially involves exchanging goods, stocks, forex, and digital currencies to benefit from market price fluctuations. Unlike investing, which often focuses on long-term growth, trading capitalizes on short-term market movements.
faqs.faq_q_2: How long does it take to master trading?
faqs.faq_a_2: There's no fixed time to master trading, but based on our educational plan, we estimate that a student needs 6 to 9 months to acquire skills and knowledge. As for mastery, it depends entirely on follow-up and personal market experience (market analysis calls with the expert are very important for skill acquisition).
faqs.faq_q_3: How long does it take to complete the education?
faqs.faq_a_3: Trading is a vast world, so the amount of information that can be acquired is tremendous, and it doesn't depend on time factor as you'll learn a new lesson every day even over years. As for our educational plan, we estimate two days for each lesson - one day for watching and one day for application and correction.
faqs.faq_a_4: It's deceptively simple. It's one of the most challenging fields one can choose to enter, but if mastered, it will be a qualitative shift in your life. Contrary to what you see on social media, trading is not just a strategy, not just a stock, not just a pattern you wait for - it's much broader and more comprehensive than that.
faqs.faq_q_5: When will I start profiting from trading?
faqs.faq_a_5: Let me rephrase the question: Can I stop losing? The answer comes after practicing on a demo (virtual) account and after your trainer sees that you're following specific risk management and decides when you can enter with a real account and start profiting with defined risk management.
faqs.faq_q_6: Does your academy provide comprehensive education from zero to mastery?
faqs.faq_a_6: Yes, the academy provides education starting from Forex world basics, then moving to classical technical analysis, then to fundamental and economic analysis, then we start with liquidity analysis, along with weekly market analyses to conclude our educational program with mastery.
faqs.faq_q_7: Are there any monthly subscription fees?
faqs.faq_a_7: There are no fees for education as it's a one-time payment and provides weekly analysis for one month, after which monthly payment is required to continue with weekly analyses and market analysis.
faqs.faq_q_8: Can I learn whenever I want?
faqs.faq_a_8: Yes, the calls are recorded and students can learn at any time they wish.
faqs.faq_q_9: Why do most traders lose at the beginning?
faqs.faq_a_9: Risk management is one of the most important foundations of trading, which we focus on in our educational curriculum, and it can reduce your losses and increase profit opportunities.
faqs.faq_q_10: What is the minimum capital I can start trading with?
faqs.faq_a_10: No one can determine your capital, but you can ask yourself what amount of daily profit would you be satisfied with in the Forex market, considering it should be 1-3 percent of the capital.
